headline: DFC opens door to US investment in Bangladesh’s development projects

members.title: DFC opens door to US investment in Bangladesh’s development projects
members.lead: The United States’ development finance institution, the US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC), has opened up avenues for financing development projects in Bangladesh. The agency formally announced on Monday that Bangladesh is now eligible to receive its financing. According to a press release published on the DFC website, the decision creates opportunities for US private-sector investment in Bangladesh’s energy, critical infrastructure and technology sectors. . It further said that under the DFC’s financing and risk-mitigation facilities, eligible projects in Bangladesh will be able to secure funding. This will help bridge investment gaps and facilitate the implementation of commercially viable projects that have been constrained by a lack of financing. As a result, the initiative is expected to create jobs, improve the quality of essential services and strengthen local businesses. DFC Chief Executive Officer Ben Black said, “Bangladesh’s eligibility for DFC financing marks an important opportunity to deepen our economic partnership and mobilise private investment that delivers lasting growth.” . “By supporting projects that strengthen critical infrastructure, we can unlock economic opportunity for Bangladesh while advancing U.S. strategic interests,” he added. US Ambassador to Bangladesh Brent T Christensen said, “The United States believes that promoting open economies and reciprocal trade will spur economic growth in Bangladesh, and the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade is our public commitment to supporting Bangladesh through this process. DFC financing can play an important role in making that vision a reality – spurring further prosperity in both of our countries,” The DFC said more than half of the world’s population lives in the Indo-Pacific region, which is also home to several of the world’s fastest-growing economies. . members.title: Bangladesh welcomes eligibility for DFC financing
members.lead: The Government of Bangladesh welcomes the announcement by the US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) making projects in Bangladesh eligible for DFC financing. This development reflects the Government of Bangladesh’s sustained diplomatic engagement with the US Government and marks an important milestone in further strengthening bilateral relations and expanding opportunities for investment and economic cooperation, says a media release by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Monday. . Eligibility for DFC financing is expected to open new avenues for attracting US investment, mobilising private capital, and facilitating commercially viable, development-oriented projects in Bangladesh. .DFC opens door to US investment in Bangladesh’s development projects. It is expected to facilitate greater participation of US businesses, strengthen investor confidence, and support the development and sustainable economic growth in Bangladesh. . The eligibility also reflects growing confidence of the international community in Bangladesh’s economic prospects and the ongoing reform initiatives of the present government to improve the investment climate, enhance the business environment, and strengthen labor standards. The Government of Bangladesh looks forward to translating access to DFC financing into tangible investment, stronger economic ties, and shared prosperity for the peoples of Bangladesh and the United States.
